evidence.title: lucide-animated | Free Animated React Icons Library

name: lucide-animated
summary: Open-source collection of 467 animated React icons built on Lucide and powered by Motion, installable one by one with the shadcn CLI.
description: A gallery of 467 animated icons, each based on a Lucide icon and rebuilt as a React component that animates on hover, with all standard SVG props forwarded. Icons install one at a time with a shadcn CLI command (@lucide-animated/<name>) or can be copied from the code; per-icon markdown docs, a full docs corpus, an agent skill and an MCP endpoint are included. MIT licensed, with community ports for Svelte, Vue, Angular and Flutter.
contains: built with the Motion animation engine
installs one icon at a time with the shadcn CLI (@lucide-animated/<name>)
icons animate on hover and forward standard SVG props
per-icon docs, agent skill and full docs corpus
MCP endpoint with search, list and get tools
community ports: Svelte, Vue, Angular, Flutter
